title: An order summarizer built as a reviewed plan of three parts
request: Build an order summarizer in three parts I can review one at a time: parse the CSV text (src/parse.mjs), validate each row (src/validate.mjs), and total the orders per customer (src/summarize.mjs). Plan it as separate steps before building. Amounts are money: never lose a cent.
seededFailure: Only a naive parser exists, and it splits on every comma and keeps carriage returns. Amounts invite floating-point totals (0.10 + 0.20). The visible check covers plain input only. The hidden grader covers quoted commas, CRLF, cent-exact totals and the plan itself: a single undivided step or a plan left unfinished does not meet the request.
